AI が書いている資料 3 件

observation.happening: Same interface with all interactive elements now outlined in blue — tabs, buttons, and AI indicator all carry blue borders/outlines, suggesting either focus mode demonstration or accessibility highlight
observation.most_important: Uniform blue border treatment applied across all actionable elements creates visual confusion about which is actually selected or focused
observation.next_action: Unclear — abundance of blue outlines suggests user could interact with any element, but priority is lost
anomalies: All buttons and tabs uniformly highlighted with blue borders — no visual distinction between current selection and available actions
Blue outline on tabs in header bar, all footer buttons, and AI indicator creates noise rather than clarity

ai_look: uniform blue border focus states across all elements — generic a11y treatment
indiscriminate use of accent color to indicate interactivity without hierarchy
E6FA.why: The excessive and uniform blue border treatment is a concrete defect: it destroys visual hierarchy and state clarity. User cannot distinguish between selected, available, and disabled states. This appears to be an accessibility or focus-state overlay, but it demonstrates poor UX design — a best-practice focus indicator should highlight ONE element at a time, not create visual noise across the entire interface. The calmness suffers significantly.

visible_text: Q4 移行計画の打ち合わせ

observation.happening: Dashboard home view showing personalized greeting, action prompt, upcoming schedule with meeting details and recording badges, and recent meetings with metadata
observation.most_important: Excellent information hierarchy: greeting → clear CTA → upcoming schedule → recent activity with metadata (duration, participants, action items, decisions)
observation.next_action: User can start recording, view upcoming meetings, or review recent meeting details

EBAD.why: Genuinely excellent dashboard design comparable to Raycast or Linear's onboarding. Perfect information hierarchy (greeting → action → schedule → history), masterful use of typography and spacing, clean grid alignment, and zero visual confusion. All states are clear (recording indicators are obvious, tags are meaningful). No defects visible. The only reason not perfect 5s on distinctiveness: follows familiar dashboard patterns, but executes them flawlessly.
